project.name: PhoenicisNex
project.type: MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (EA) — single-instrument retail Forex EA (EURUSD H4)
project.mission: Greenfield rewrite of PhoenicisN2.10_stable.mq5 (22k LOC MQL5 EA) to fix maintainability (≥80 inputs, slot-per-file ≤5k LOC), add observability (JSON-Lines trade journal), fix 2 critical safety bugs (BI naked SL + ExtraTakeProfit_J magic), preserve behavioral parity (≤25% Net Profit deviation on 5-yr EURUSD H4 baseline).

services.name: ea
services.framework: MetaTrader 5 platform (intra-MT5 modular monolith per ADR-001)
services.test_framework: MT5 Strategy Tester headless (terminal64.exe /config:tester.ini per mt5-headless-backtest skill); compile via MetaEditor64.exe /compile per mql-developer skill; log review via mt5-log-reader skill
services.naming_conventions: m_<member>, g_<global>, Inp<SlotId><Param>; group="Slot <X>" annotation; 5-layer (core/slots/services/domain/helpers per ADR-012); E<Name> enum prefix
services.response_envelope: N/A (intra-process contracts via JSON Schema in docs/api-specs/*.yaml — slot-abstraction-contract.yaml, marketcontext-snapshot-schema.yaml, state-persistence-schema.yaml, trade-journal-schema.yaml)
services.entry_command: MetaEditor compile → drop .ex5 + .mq5 + libs into MT5 Experts/PhoenicisNex/ → attach to EURUSD H4 chart

database.engine: File-based (no RDBMS per ADR-001 + NFR-7.2 + C-12)
database.migration_tool: n/a (Phase 2 SQLite migration plan per ADR-006/007 § Revisit-when)
storage_artifacts: MQL5/Files/PhoenicisNex/state/state.json (atomic write per ADR-007 — 35 fields / 11 sub-objects, schema state-persistence-schema.yaml)
MQL5/Files/PhoenicisNex/journal/{live,tester}/journal-YYYYMM.jsonl (JSON-Lines per ADR-006 — 15 required + 8 optional, schema trade-journal-schema.yaml)
MT5 GlobalVariable mirror (5 entries — subset of state.watch_profits per TD-02 §6.1.1 sync rule)

cross_cutting.auth_flow: N/A — solo operator, no network listener; symbol whitelist in OnInit (_Symbol == "EURUSD") per NFR-5.3 + FR-1.2
cross_cutting.observability: Tagged structured logger (ADR-011) — sinks: MT5 native Print() + Alert() only (Phase 1). Format: [slot=<X>][ev=<E>][magic=<N>] with ms-precision timestamps + LRU eviction + N-consecutive escalation per ADR-011

containerization.source: inferred (heuristic: single intra-MT5-process EA with no managed/serverless host — matches "Otherwise → none" rule)
containerization.rationale: PhoenicisNex runs as MQL5 EA inside MT5 client process on user's Windows machine; NFR-7.2 = 0 external DLLs + C-12 = "วาง .ex5 แล้วรัน" preclude any container runtime

api_conventions.style: N/A (no external HTTP/REST/GraphQL/gRPC — all contracts intra-process)
api_conventions.intra_process_contracts: 4 JSON Schema YAML in docs/api-specs/ (slot-abstraction-contract.yaml, marketcontext-snapshot-schema.yaml, state-persistence-schema.yaml, trade-journal-schema.yaml)

ux_conventions.status: N/A — UX phase officially skipped 2026-05-02 (MT5 native UI only per TD-03 §1)
